description: Cotton / synthetic fabric wet processing units — knits or wovens. Typical Indian cluster: Tirupur (Tamil Nadu), Surat (Gujarat), Ludhiana (Punjab), Panipat (Haryana). Water and thermal-energy intensive; effluent treatment obligatory.

unit_processes.name: Pre-treatment (Scouring, Bleaching, Desizing)
unit_processes.notes: Uses hot water and alkaline chemistry to prepare fabric for dyeing.

unit_processes.name: Dyeing (Jet / Jigger / Winch — bath heating)
unit_processes.notes: Largest single thermal-energy user. Bath heated to 60-130 C depending on dye class.

unit_processes.name: Drying and Curing (Stenter, Dryer)
unit_processes.notes: Second-largest thermal user. Fabric passed through a heated chamber. Exhaust is a major recoverable-heat source.

unit_processes.name: Effluent Treatment Plant and Utilities (Compressed Air, Cooling, Lighting)
unit_processes.notes: In ZLD-mandated clusters (Tirupur), ETP energy share is even higher due to RO stages.

activities_expected.description: Biomass (bagasse / rice husk) purchase for boiler (if applicable)

sources: BEE Perform Achieve Trade (PAT) sectoral document — Textiles
TIFAC Assessment of Carbon Impact at Tirupur cluster
CITI (Confederation of Indian Textile Industry) energy benchmark studies
SITRA (South India Textile Research Association) energy audit reports
